integrity: Analytical proof supplied with an exact finite diagnostic; no external mathematical certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion concerns unweighted centered graphical zonotopes of finite trees in canonical Euclidean incidence coordinates and uniform vertex sampling. It is not a theorem on arbitrary graphs, weighted deformations, interior-volume sampling or angularly selected vertices. Published-equivalent formulations under random-orientation terminology remain a residual bibliographic risk; finite checks are not all-order proofs.
title: Degree-sequence rigidity of the complete Euclidean vertex-radius spectrum of tree zonotopes
